meta.name: Challenge Accepted
meta.description:
Challenge Accepted follows Michelle Khare as she attempts the world's most difficult lifestyles, stunts, and professions.

Shows: I Trained Like A Victoria's Secret Model for 5 Weeks, I Tried Marine Bootcamp, I Trained Like a NASA Astronaut, I Trained Like An NFL Player, I Trained Like A Pop Star For 60 Days
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
